This [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''Nikto''' served on the [[Deep Space Demolition and Removal]] [[Space station/Legends|Space station]] in [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]]. The [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] greeted [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] when he arrived at the station that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].<ref name="DP" />
